name: GogBot
description: Runs daily habit check-ins in the style of David Goggins — blunt, loud, and unwilling to accept excuses — and keeps a record of what you did or skipped that you cannot go back and edit. Suits people who want confrontation rather than encouragement; a poor fit if shouting makes you shut down.

official.title: GogBot by Hunter
official.description: David Goggins in your pocket. The accountability mirror that talks back. Raw, loud, no fluff. Daily habit check-ins and a log you cannot rewrite. Never...
